records.coverage: Tamil Nadu - Community Certificate service REV-101
records.description: Tamil Nadu e-Sevai lists Community Certificate as a Revenue service. Check the current certificate type and applicable evidence with the service before applying.
steps: Choose the appropriate revenue certificate through the citizen service or an e-Sevai centre.
Follow that service’s instructions and retain the application acknowledgement.
conditions: This option is for Tamil Nadu. Community Certificate and OBC Certificate are separately listed services.

records.coverage: Tamil Nadu - administrative Legal Heir Certificate service REV-114
records.description: Apply through the published e-Sevai route for an administrative legal-heir certificate. A court-issued succession certificate is a different legal process; this is not an application for one.
steps: Choose the appropriate revenue certificate through the citizen service or an e-Sevai centre.
Follow that service’s instructions and retain the application acknowledgement.
conditions: The administrative Legal Heir Certificate is not a court-issued succession certificate.
The Chennai district workflow lists the Tahsildar as approver and uses the deceased person's residence before death.
Confirm which document the bank or receiving institution needs; this administrative certificate does not replace a court succession certificate.

records.coverage: Tamil Nadu - Residence Certificate REV-116 and Nativity Certificate REV-102
records.description: The official service list provides separate residence and nativity certificate routes. Confirm the exact certificate required for your purpose before applying.
steps: Choose the appropriate revenue certificate through the citizen service or an e-Sevai centre.
Follow that service’s instructions and retain the application acknowledgement.
conditions: This is a Tamil Nadu option. Residence, nativity and domicile requirements are not interchangeable across all jurisdictions.

records.department: Tamil Nadu Revenue and Disaster Management Department
records.coverage: Tamil Nadu land records
records.description: View Patta, Chitta, FMB and related revenue records. Land-record extracts and an Encumbrance Certificate use separate services.
steps: Choose the relevant record service.
Enter the property identifiers requested by that service and review the result.
conditions: Choose the record and rural/urban coverage relevant to the property. An extract is not itself an application to change ownership.

records.coverage: Registered-property records within Tamil Nadu
records.description: Use the Registration Department’s Encumbrance Certificate service for registration entries; Patta and survey records are handled separately.
steps: Read the official EC application manual.
Use the EC service and retain its acknowledgement.
conditions: The EC service covers registration records. Confirm the required search period and property particulars on the official portal.
records.offlineOption: An e-Sevai centre can help identify the listed Encumbrance Certificate service.

records.department: Tamil Nadu Commissioner of Social Security Scheme / e-Sevai
records.coverage: Tamil Nadu social-security pension schemes
records.description: The official social-security pension page directs citizen applications to e-Sevai. Select the applicable old-age, widow or disability scheme.
steps: Select the appropriate social-security scheme at e-Sevai or its service centre.
Review its requirements before applying.
conditions: This is the social-security pension route. The OAP site’s sign-in is for back-office users; it is not the citizen application form.
Eligibility depends on the selected scheme.
Old-age, widow and disability schemes have different eligibility conditions. This record does not establish an applicant's eligibility.

contactEmail.purpose: Commissioner of Social Security Scheme contact

records.responsibility: Revenue officials verify applications; the Special Tahsildar for Social Security Schemes issues orders for eligible applicants.

records.department: Tamil Nadu Mudhalvarin Mugavari / CM Helpline
records.coverage: Tamil Nadu government departments and applicable public services
records.description: Use this channel to follow up on a public-service grievance with the responsible state authority. It does not replace the service application.
steps: Review the portal’s remit and select the appropriate department.
Explain the unresolved issue and include any existing application or complaint reference.
Retain the grievance reference for follow-up.
conditions: For service-delivery complaints within the listed jurisdiction; not a certificate, benefit or permit application.

records.coverage: Karnataka; service and jurisdiction must be chosen on Nadakacheri
records.description: The official service list includes caste, domicile and Surviving Family Members certificates. Choose the precise service needed.
steps: Review Nadakacheri’s service list and follow Apply Online for the matching service.
For an unavailable service or portal error, contact the Nadakacheri helpdesk or office.
conditions: A Surviving Family Members Certificate does not replace a judicial succession certificate.
Online availability and the responsible office depend on the specific service.

records.coverage: Karnataka revenue land records
records.description: Bhoomi provides RTC and mutation-related land-record services. Use the property’s applicable revenue-record service.
steps: Select the relevant land-record or mutation service.
Confirm the district, taluk, village and property identifiers on the official portal.
conditions: Bhoomi revenue records are distinct from registration Encumbrance Certificates and urban property-account services.

records.department: Karnataka Department of Stamps and Registration — Kaveri 2.0
records.coverage: Karnataka registered-document and Encumbrance Certificate services
records.description: This official government overview identifies Kaveri 2.0 for EC and registration services. It is guidance, not an application form.
conditions: A current direct Kaveri application destination was not confirmed in this review. Confirm it with the Registration Department before entering personal details.

records.department: Karnataka Revenue Department — Nadakacheri social-security pensions
records.coverage: Karnataka; scheme-specific eligibility
records.description: Nadakacheri’s service list includes social-security pensions, including disability, old-age and Sandhya Suraksha services.
conditions: Choose the applicable pension scheme. The student State Scholarship Portal is not this pension route.

Retain the grievance reference for follow-up.
conditions: For service-delivery complaints within the listed jurisdiction; not a certificate, benefit or permit application.

records.coverage: Maharashtra; relevant revenue district

Follow its application instructions or consult an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra.
conditions: Certificate types have different eligibility and evidence requirements. No general legal-heir application route has been verified here.

records.description: Mahabhumi links to records of rights, property-card services and the appropriate mutation application systems.
conditions: Choose the rural, urban or Mumbai mutation service appropriate to the property. Viewing a record is a separate action from requesting a change.

records.department: Maharashtra Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
records.coverage: Maharashtra social-assistance schemes
records.description: Official guidance links to Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar, Shravanbal and national old-age, widow and disability pension schemes.

Follow its How To Apply instructions; the cited scheme pages direct applications to the relevant Collector, Tehsildar, scheme branch or Talathi office.
conditions: This is an official scheme directory, not a universal online pension application.

records.coverage: Maharashtra government departments and applicable district authorities

Retain the grievance reference for follow-up.
conditions: For service-delivery complaints within the listed jurisdiction; not a certificate, benefit or permit application.

records.department: Uttar Pradesh e-District / e-Sathi — Revenue services
records.coverage: Uttar Pradesh; relevant district and approving authority
records.description: e-District provides caste and residence-certificate services and links to the e-Sathi citizen portal.
steps: Choose the matching certificate and read its current service instructions.
Use the linked e-Sathi citizen portal or an authorized service centre.
conditions: No general legal-heir application route has been verified in this record.

records.department: Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue — Bhulekh

records.description: Bhulekh provides the state’s real-time Khatauni service. Select the applicable record using the property identifiers.
conditions: This land-record lookup is not an Encumbrance Certificate or a universal mutation application.

records.coverage: Uttar Pradesh social-pension schemes
records.description: The state pension system covers old-age, widow, disability and leprosy-pension services. Choose the relevant scheme.
conditions: Eligibility, application options and the responsible department differ by scheme.

records.coverage: Uttar Pradesh government service-delivery grievances
records.description: Use this channel to follow up on a public-service grievance with the responsible state authority. It does not replace the service application.
steps: Review the portal’s remit and select the appropriate department.
Explain the unresolved issue and include any existing application or complaint reference.
Retain the grievance reference for follow-up.
conditions: Follow-up for government service delivery, not a new benefit or certificate application.
The portal excludes matters such as RTI, subjudice cases and requests for financial assistance or employment. Review its full exclusions.

contactEmail.purpose: Jansunwai website queries; submit grievances through the portal

records.coverage: Government of NCT of Delhi; competent revenue subdivision
records.description: Delhi’s official certificate guidance includes caste, domicile and Surviving Members certificates. Choose the relevant Revenue Department service.
steps: Read the service-specific guidance, then use e-District’s Apply Service option.
Retain the application reference for tracking.
conditions: A Surviving Members Certificate is not a judicial succession certificate.
Check the applicable residence, caste and certificate-purpose conditions on the selected official service.

records.department: Delhi Department of Revenue — Indraprastha Bhu-Lekh
records.coverage: Delhi revenue records covered by the DLR or PLR systems
records.description: View Khasra/Khatauni or Jamabandi details on the current Delhi land-records portal.
conditions: The portal displays information; contact the relevant revenue tehsil for other record questions or changes.

conditions: The legacy DORIS page says all sub-registrar offices have migrated to NGDRS. Choose the correct period for historical searches.

conditions: Availability and eligibility must be confirmed for the selected scheme; these are not universal pension rules.

records.coverage: Delhi government departments, local bodies and covered organizations
records.description: The Commission provides a grievance-redressal route for complaints concerning covered public authorities. Review its remit before contacting it.
conditions: This is the Commission’s contact and guidance page, not the PGMS application portal.

records.coverage: Telangana; relevant revenue mandal and certificate purpose
records.description: MeeSeva lists integrated caste/nativity certificates and residence-certificate services. Select the exact certificate required.
conditions: Certificate purposes and conditions differ; review the chosen service.

records.department: Telangana Revenue Department — MeeSeva Family Member Certificate
records.coverage: Telangana; the listed Family Member Certificate covers social-security schemes and government employees/pensioners
records.description: The service directory lists a Family Member Certificate for specific social-security and government employee/pensioner purposes.
conditions: Confirm that your purpose fits the listed service. Do not treat this as a general court-issued succession certificate.

contactPhone.purpose: MeeSeva enquiry published by the district service page

records.coverage: Telangana land-record and land-transaction services covered by Bhu Bharati
records.description: The current state directory identifies Bhu Bharati for land services, including mutation and passbook-related requests.
steps: Review the official instructions for the exact land service.
Register or sign in and retain the transaction reference.
conditions: Choose the applicable land service. An EC or another registration search may require a separate Registration Department service.

records.description: The state MeeSeva directory lists the Registration Department’s Encumbrance Certificate form separately from revenue land services.
conditions: Choose the Registration section’s Encumbrance Certificate service. This directory itself does not submit the application.

records.department: Telangana Rural Development — Aasara social-security pensions
records.coverage: Telangana; selected Aasara scheme and applicable eligibility
records.description: The current state directory links to Aasara pensions. The government’s mobile-services guidance also describes pension applications through MeeSeva.
conditions: Follow the current Aasara link from the official directory or consult MeeSeva for the relevant application.
A direct pension application form was not verified during this review; eligibility and application availability must be confirmed.

records.coverage: Telangana public grievances; submission through the offices described on the official page
records.description: The current Prajavani page explains petition submission at Praja Bhavan and lists district, division and mandal offices. The online citizen options provide receipts and grievance-status tracking.
steps: Consult Reach Us and confirm the relevant Prajavani office and submission arrangements.
Submit the reviewed petition through the stated office process.
Use your mobile number or reference ID to retrieve the receipt and track status online.
conditions: The listed website is guidance and tracking; it is not a verified online new-petition submission form.
A grievance is follow-up for the relevant public authority, not a replacement service application.
